groups.name: transcript_discrimination
groups.domain: All two-outcome P,Q on the quarter grid and randomized binary decisions on the quarter grid.

groups.name: stable_partition
groups.domain: Every ternary labeling and every single transition function on three states; all state pairs. Pair-orbit comparison is independent of partition refinement.

groups.name: multi_operation_refinement
groups.domain: Every binary labeling and ordered pair of transition functions on two states, and all pairs of states.

groups.name: synthesis_vs_unpruned_trees
groups.domain: All 256 ordered pairs of binary transition/report tables on two states, every nonempty initial support, and horizons 0,1,2. Two unique repairs; experiment costs 1 and 2, repair cost 1.

groups.name: partial_domains_and_reset
groups.domain: A query illegal in one possible state; a destructive reset; and an immutable-origin variant. Horizons 0 through 3.

groups.name: repair_relevance_not_full_identification
groups.domain: Four equiprobable static states, repair partition {0,1,2}|{3}, two binary queries, horizon 2.

groups.name: execution_storage_tradeoff
groups.domain: Four static cases, direct four-valued query cost 4, singleton queries cost 1, zero-cost unique repairs, horizon 3.

groups.name: hidden_cell_costs
groups.domain: Powers of two 2,4,8,16,32; every hidden cell; equality and bit trees. Compiler separately checked at n=2,4,8 with optimal bit depth.

groups.name: complete_investigation_transport
groups.domain: All 32 affine cell permutations i -> a*i+b modulo 8, a odd, all 8 flips of the three bit-report labels; all eight initial cells. Exact common costs, repairs and branch correspondence.

groups.name: missing_observation_transport
groups.domain: Two identical singleton repair sets but a source revealing query and target constant query; horizons 0 through 4.

groups.name: invalid_witnesses
groups.domain: Malformed tree nodes, missing/duplicate/extraneous branches, wrong repairs, depth, work/storage bounds, invalid models, and serialization checks.

groups.name: selection_and_transfer_margins
groups.domain: Three true values on the half grid in [-1,1], all perturbations in {-1/4,0,1/4}; every pair of transferred values on the same grid.

groups.name: grammar_dilution
groups.domain: Uniform independent sampling with replacement, candidate counts 1..16, budgets 0..10, exactly one useful candidate.

groups.name: amortization_and_ceiling
groups.domain: Integer startup cost 0..10, positive rational saving 1/4..8/4, 0..20 uses; score interval [0,1] with gamma 1/k for k=1..20; 30 summable increments.

groups.name: conditional_lineage_budget
groups.domain: Three rounds with error caps (1/4,1/8,1/16), all 128 history-dependent hazard choices of either zero or that cap.

groups.name: recursive_progress_vs_policy_enumeration
groups.domain: Two states, two actions per state, all nonempty successor subsets, action-constant progress marks 0 or 1: 1296 models; three nonempty safe sets; horizons and targets 0..2.

groups.name: retry_and_dead_end_controls
groups.domain: A rejection self-loop with a possible marked successor, and a locally safe transition into a state with no safe continuation; horizons 0..6.

groups.name: operation_continuation
groups.domain: Three-register F_5 instrument, all 125 states, every word of H/W/J of length at most four, q=(a+b,b,c), explicit reduced updates.

non_claims: Not neural training or a demonstration of general intelligence.
Not an empirical self-improving compiler. The compiler and model family are supplied.
Finite checks support these implementations; general results rest on the prose proofs.
Project-authored cross-checks are not independent external validation.
